description: Design a game Artemis 2 to help kids know about important space events. It also developes engeenering skills and buget control.
summary: We developed a digital game called Artemis 2. Artemis 2 is an educational game that teaches chilldren about one of the most important events in human history. It also developes engineering.
details: To run the game you have to download the code and open the file you dowloaded. The game has 2 main parts building the spacecraft and the mission. When the player chooses the important parts of the spacecraft he has to chek is his rocket wheight under 100kg unless he will not be able to launch the spacecraft. `Whe the mission starts the player has to avoid the metiorides on his way and chooes to use his tools\parts that he put in rocket when he was building the rocket or ignore them. he will loose some fuel and health during the mission and it depends on how much damage he has during the mission. One of the most exiting things in this game is that it. is baset compleatly on true event so the problems that apear during the sesion were real in Artemis 2 space mission, and the timing is matching to Artemis 2 timing too. This project was made in 2 days without any game engine. It was coded by HTML, CSS and Javascript.
